==Notes==
The Wretched Wolf begins as an ally, but periodically walks up to the norn taunting it, turns into an enemy and attacks the two [[Norn Guard Captain|Norn Guard Captains]] (or the party if in range). When its health goes below 15%, it turns into an ally, and returns to its initial position while healing itself, before restarting the cycle after about half a minute. If it manages to kill both [[Norn Guard Captain|Norn Guard Captains]], it loiters around its initial location as enemy (but not attacking any other NPCs), until the [[Norn Guard Captain|Norn Guard Captains]] revive themselves, at which point it attacks them again.
